disposition_reason: Screen-house experiment growing sweet pepper in soils from three distances to artisanal gold mining; fruit Hg, Pb and As reported per harvest for the two soils that produced fruit.

study.design: single-factor screen-house pot experiment, 3 soils x 3 replicate pots, 4 harvests
study.origin: grown in screen house, University of Cordoba, Monteria, Colombia, in soils from San Martin de Loba, Bolivar
study.period_text: March to May 2018 (143-day trial as stated)
study.method: Hg by direct mercury analyzer (EPA 7473); Pb by flame AAS and As by hydride-generation AAS after microwave HNO3/H2O2 digestion (EPA 3051A); plant parts dried and ground
study.lod_text: plant tissue: As 50 µg/kg, Pb 80 µg/kg, Hg 0.1 µg/kg
study.qa: IAEA-336 lichen CRM recoveries As 106.3%, Pb 103.4%, Hg 105%; 10% duplicates

unresolved: S3 distance is printed as 20 km in the abstract and 10 km in the methods.
Trial period printed as March to May 2018 but the abstract gives 143 days of growth.
Fruit basis (fresh or dry) not stated in Table 4; plant parts were dried and ground before analysis.
Abstract states Hg exceeded the 0.1 mg/kg GB 2762 threshold, but Table 4 cites 0.01 mg/kg for Hg and 0.1 mg/kg for Pb.
Pepper colour and cultivar name not stated (seeds from local inhabitants, single variety).
